data.title: 木更 · 深夜浴室
data.description: 浴室的花洒喷洒出滚烫的水雾，湿透的粉发贴在木更纤细滑腻的后背与饱满的胸口。她转身将你拉进淋浴的水幕中，紧紧贴住你的胸膛，眼神近乎痴迷——「修的心跳声好清楚……洗完澡之后，今晚一整夜……都绝对不准离开我的视线哦。」
data.action: 淋浴水幕中紧贴胸膛，湿发贴身眼神痴迷
data.camera: side view, medium shot, horizontal framing
data.promptProse: In a side view through the shower spray, adult Kisara rests against adult Shu Ogata, her long wet pink hair curling down her back. Shu's short brown hair, taller build and broad shoulders form the other side of the embrace. Warm bathroom light diffuses through the steam around their joined silhouettes.
data.animaCaption: Adult Kisara's long wet pink hair falls down her back as she leans into adult Shu Ogata, whose short brown hair and broad shoulders are visible above hers in the side view.
